info.name: Workings API
info.description: API collection for Workings app - Development

request.description: Server health check / welcome endpoint. Returns API status. Public endpoint.
Logs out the user and clears tokens. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Sends a password reset email. Check server logs for reset token if email is not configured.
Resets password using token from forgot-password email. Token is valid for 15 minutes.
Refreshes access and refresh tokens. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
OAuth sign-in with Google. Pass a valid Google ID token. companyName is required only on first sign-up. Public endpoint.

query.description: Email verification token sent to the user at registration

request.description: Verifies a user's email using the token from the verification email. Public endpoint.

query.description: Email change confirmation token sent to the new email

request.description: Confirms a user-initiated email change using token from confirmation email. Public endpoint.
Resends the verification email to the authenticated user. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Logs in an administrator and returns access/refresh tokens. Public endpoint.
Logs out the administrator and clears session cookies/tokens. Requires admin session.
Changes the password of the currently authenticated administrator. Requires admin session.
Gets user profile. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Updates user profile (name, email, companyName). All fields are optional. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Changes user password. Requires current password verification. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Updates user bank details. All fields are required. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets user points transaction history with pagination. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Sets the initial password for an OAuth-linked user account. Requires session authentication.
Deactivates the authenticated user's own account. Requires session authentication.
Runs calculation engine on Project Cart. Points are deducted after successful calculation. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Verifies frontend calculation results against backend calculation. No points deduction. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Syncs offline project data with backend. Backend runs calculations and stores results. Points are deducted for each project synced. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Retrieves the user's material catalog (with dynamic system/manual pricing). Requires user session.
Retrieves pricing information for items to pre-fill calculations. Requires user session.
Previews costs and material lists without saving. Requires user session.
Calculates and saves estimation quote, deducting 3 points. Requires user session.
Lists all accessories with optional filtering and pagination. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets list of all accessory categories. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets single accessory by ID. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Creates a new accessory in the catalog. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Updates an accessory. All fields are optional. Price changes are automatically added to price history. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Deletes an accessory from the catalog. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

Creates a new draft project with minimal information (projectName, customer.name, siteAddress). Description is optional. glazingDimensions is optional - can be added later via update. Points are NOT deducted on creation. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Lists all projects for the authenticated user with pagination and optional filtering. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

query.description: Search query (searches in project name and customer name)

request.description: Searches projects by name or customer name. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets a single project by ID. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

Updates project details. All fields are optional. Use this to add glazingDimensions to a draft project. You can update projectName, customer, siteAddress, description, glazingDimensions, calculationSettings, or status. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Deletes a project and all associated material lists, cutting lists, and glass cutting lists. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

Runs calculation on project's glazing dimensions and stores results in MaterialList, CuttingList, and GlassCuttingList. Points are deducted based on modules used. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets the latest material list for a project. Returns 404 if project has no calculations yet. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets a single material list by ID. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets the latest cutting list for a project. Returns 404 if project has no calculations yet. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets a single cutting list by ID. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

item.name: Get Glass Cutting List by Project

request.description: Gets the latest glass cutting list for a project. Returns 404 if project has no calculations yet. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

item.name: Get Glass Cutting List by ID

request.description: Gets a single glass cutting list by ID. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

request.description: Creates a new quote (from project OR standalone). Points deduction: 3 points. For 'from_project', include projectId. For 'standalone', set projectId to null. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Lists all quotes for the authenticated user with pagination and optional filtering. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets a single quote by ID. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Updates a quote. All fields are optional. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Deletes a quote. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Generates a PDF for the quote and returns the PDF URL. Points deduction: 1 point. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Sends quote via email to customer. Updates quote status to 'sent'. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets all available subscription plans with pricing and features. Public endpoint (no authentication required).

Initiates payment for subscription. Returns authorization URL for payment. Plan options: 'free', 'starter', 'pro', 'enterprise'. Billing cycle: 'monthly' or 'yearly'. paymentProvider (optional): 'paystack', 'flutterwave', or 'monnify' - defaults to system priority. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets user's current subscription details including plan, billing cycle, expiration date, and points balance. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Cancels user's subscription and moves them to free tier. Reason is optional. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets list of currently enabled payment providers (paystack/flutterwave/monnify). Public endpoint (no authentication required).
Gets the authenticated user's subscription history (past plans, payments, cancellations). Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Upgrades subscription plan with proration. Plan options: 'starter', 'pro', 'enterprise'. Billing cycle: 'monthly' or 'yearly'. paymentProvider is optional. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Schedules a subscription downgrade (effective at end of current billing cycle). Plan options: 'free', 'starter', 'pro'. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

Manually verifies a payment and activates subscription (production-safe fallback for when webhook fails). Provider options: 'paystack', 'flutterwave', 'monnify'. plan and billingCycle are optional. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

header.description: Provider-specific webhook signature header. Use 'x-paystack-signature' for Paystack, 'verif-hash' for Flutterwave, or appropriate header for Monnify.

request.description: Generic payment webhook endpoint. Replace 'paystack' in path with 'flutterwave' or 'monnify' as needed. Verifies signature and processes payment events. Server-to-server (no auth required - verified by signature). Body shape varies by provider.

header.description: HMAC SHA512 signature from Paystack. Required for webhook verification.

request.description: Legacy Paystack-specific webhook (kept for backward compatibility). Use 'Webhook (Provider)' above for new integrations. Events: 'charge.success', 'charge.failed'.

Gets all template configurations (quoteFormat, paymentMethods, paymentMethodConfig, pdfExport, materialPrices, materialPricesConfig) for the authenticated user. Returns defaults if none have been saved. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

Creates or replaces ALL template configurations for the authenticated user. All top-level fields (quoteFormat, paymentMethods, paymentMethodConfig, pdfExport, materialPrices, materialPricesConfig) are required. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets all payment methods for the authenticated user. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Creates a new payment method. All fields are required. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Updates a payment method. All fields are optional (accountName, accountNumber, bankName, isDefault). Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Deletes a payment method. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets all material prices for the authenticated user with optional filtering. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Creates a new material price. Category options: 'Profile', 'Glass', 'Accessory', 'Rubber', 'Other'. description is optional. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Updates a material price. All fields are optional (name, category, unit, unitPrice, description). Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Deletes a material price. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets all saved templates (presets) for the authenticated user. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).

Creates a new saved template (preset). Type options:
- 'quoteFormat': only quoteFormat field required
- 'pdfExport': only pdfExport field required
- 'full': both quoteFormat and pdfExport required
Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Updates a saved template. All fields are optional (name, quoteFormat, pdfExport). Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Deletes a saved template. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Submits a user complaint. Requires user session.
Lists registered users on the system. Requires admin privileges ('manage_users' or super_admin).
Gets global statistics about user accounts. Requires admin privileges.
Retrieves details of a specific user. Requires admin privileges.
Activates/unlocks a user account. Requires 'manage_users' or super_admin permissions.
Deactivates a user account. Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Toggles whether a user has administrative portal access. Requires super_admin.
Lists administrative portal accounts. Requires super_admin.
Lists user-submitted complaints. Requires admin privileges.
Updates the status of a complaint. Requires 'manage_system' or super_admin.
Adjusts a user's credit points balance. Requires 'manage_users' or super_admin.
Retrieves administrative points audit logs. Requires admin privileges.
TEST-ONLY (TODO: remove before launch). Credits points to a user by email. Requires the test secret. No authentication required.
Overrides a user's subscription plan. Requires 'manage_users' or super_admin.
Retrieves global subscriptions history. Requires 'manage_billing' or super_admin.
Gets full payment provider configuration (enabled/disabled status, priority, credentials presence). Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Enables a payment provider. Replace 'paystack' in path with 'flutterwave' or 'monnify' as needed. Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Disables a payment provider. Replace 'paystack' in path with 'flutterwave' or 'monnify' as needed. Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Sets payment provider priority order. Array order = priority order (first = highest). Must include at least one provider. Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets overall revenue statistics (total revenue, MRR, ARR, etc.). Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets revenue aggregated for a specific date range. Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Gets subscription business metrics (churn rate, conversion rate, plan distribution, etc.). Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Lists all currently active paid subscriptions. Requires admin privileges. Requires authentication (cookie + headers).
Retrieves administrative action audit logs. Requires 'manage_system' or super_admin.
Gets the dynamic system settings cached on the server. Requires admin privileges.
Updates global system settings (points cost, billing plans). Requires super_admin.
Lists global system material prices. Requires admin privileges.
Creates a new system material price definition. Requires 'manage_catalog' or super_admin.
Gets details of a system material price. Requires admin privileges.
Updates a system material price definition. Requires 'manage_catalog' or super_admin.
Deletes a system material price definition. Requires 'manage_catalog' or super_admin.
